info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Investment Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Management API allows for the dynamic modification of investment portfolios based on specific parameters. Through this endpoint, users can update their investment strategies, reallocating assets or adjusting profiles to better meet financial goals. This API caters primarily to financial institutions, investment managers, and analysts focused on optimizing portfolio performance. Utilize this API to respond to market changes and adjust investments efficiently while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific investment portfolio identified by its resource ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to reflect the changes you want to apply.
